research_question: What contextual repair effectiveness, validation behavior, and efficiency does a strong contemporary coding agent achieve on the unchanged ten-project reference subset under the same localization and evaluator budget?
null_hypothesis: No directional superiority hypothesis is preregistered because this is a limited contemporary reference rather than the paper's primary method claim.
alternative_hypothesis: No directional superiority hypothesis is preregistered; all effect directions, including ties or reference-agent advantages, will be reported.
research_objective: Provide a runnable contemporary coding-agent reference while preserving the original ten-project membership and avoiding a claim that HapRepair must outperform agents.

model.temperature: not explicitly configurable through the frozen Codex harness
model.nondeterminism_note: A single run remains potentially nondeterministic even without an exposed sampling-temperature control.

common_contract.source_diff_gate: Validation requires a real ArkTS/TypeScript source diff relative to the active round snapshot.
common_contract.target_coverage_gate: Every affected file for every required rule in the frozen round plan must be completed or concretely blocked before a validation scan is consumed.
common_contract.candidate_retention: Retain candidates after structural, public-API, configured build, or configured test failure and continue repair in place.
common_contract.best_valid_selection: Before the evaluator-only final scan, restore the valid candidate with the lexicographically best score over final alerts, introduced alerts, changed source files, and round.
common_contract.build_test_policy: Use only evaluator gates frozen as available in the input manifest; otherwise label the project statically validated only.
common_contract.arkts_diagnostic_policy: For configured builds, compiler ignoreWarning applies only to ArkTS checker diagnostics; later compilation, resolution, packaging, and process failures remain fatal.

scheduling.round_target_policy: Use the same complete-cluster scheduling and file-coverage contract as the HapRepair Skill condition.
scheduling.complete_cluster_policy: For every required rule, inspect every affected file and account for all localized instances before validation.
scheduling.homogeneous_batch_policy: Use reviewed mechanical batching for a demonstrated homogeneous transformation; the smallest safe edit is per instance, not a cap on files.
scheduling.interaction_policy: Feed residual and introduced alert observations into later rounds without access to HapRepair Skill interaction state.

retrieval.isolation: The reference agent cannot access the HapRepair corpus, Skill broker/state, retrieval output, independent-oracle references, or another condition's patches.

dataset.membership: The original reference subset is unchanged and includes wifi_testapp; no resampling or replacement is permitted.
dataset.source_identity: Each reference record is byte-identical metadata copied from its matching frozen 35-project input record.

execution.evaluation_date_policy: Formal run manifests record exact UTC start/completion timestamps; execution is authorized no earlier than 2026-08-04 (Asia/Shanghai).
execution.gpu_policy: Devices remain part of the common scheduler contract although the Vanilla reference does not start a retrieval broker.
execution.retry_policy: Do not automatically rerun a stochastic condition. Agent-internal no-diff and coverage retries are bounded by the round protocol. An external retry requires a documented infrastructure failure before usable condition evidence and a new audited run ID.
execution.abort_policy: On the first condition failure, stop launching new conditions, let already active conditions finish, preserve all directories and logs, and mark the scheduler stopped.
execution.resume_policy: A resumed scheduler may skip hash-matching completed conditions and launch untouched conditions. Any incomplete condition directory blocks resume pending audit; it is never deleted or silently reused.

stop_condition: Stop early only when an accepted candidate has zero target findings; otherwise stop after five post-edit validation scans and then restore best-valid for the evaluator-only final scan.
abandonment_condition: Stop and preserve evidence on input/protocol/model/provider drift, scanner failure, restricted-artifact access, bounded edit-retry exhaustion, or an incomplete formal condition.

reporting.primary: Report the full ten-project contextual reference aggregate alongside matching HapRepair Skill results from EXP-HAPSKILL-35; do not rerun Skill conditions merely to form pairs.
reporting.sensitivity: Also report the nine-project aggregate after excluding development-exposed wifi_testapp.
reporting.effect_direction: Report ties, regressions, and reference-agent advantages without reinterpretation as HapRepair improvements.

claim_boundary: This is a strong contemporary coding-agent reference, not the unique state of the art and not a preregistered superiority test. HomeCheck alert elimination is not semantic correctness.
